name: io.github.eldiegolar/mcp-vetting
title: MCP Vet — trust-scan gate
description: Vet any MCP server before installing it: static scanners (SSRF, command execution, secrets, auth posture, provenance, dependencies) return an evidence-backed verdict — SAFE_TO_INSTALL, REVIEW_BEFORE_INSTALL or DO_NOT_INSTALL — with file:line findings, plus paste-ready config adapters for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and Hermes.
